title_en: Ratka was left a young widow

lines.en: Ratka was left a young widow
Ratka hid her white face with a veil,
and mourned for her first love.

lines.cyr: Мајка на Ратка тихо ѝ говори:
lines.lat: Majka na Ratka tiho ì govori:

lines.cyr: - Не ми плачи Ратке, не жали.
lines.lat: - Ne mi plači Ratke, ne žali.

lines.cyr: Ти си ќерко, млада и убава,
lines.lat: Ti si ḱerko, mlada i ubava,
lines.en: You my daughter, you are young and beautiful,
you'll fall in love with another young man.

lines.cyr: Ратка на мајка плаче и говори:
lines.lat: Ratka na majka plače i govori:
lines.en: Ratka cried to her mother and said:

lines.cyr: - Не ми збори, мајко, не ме гори.
lines.lat: - Ne mi zbori, majko, ne me gori.
lines.en: - Don't talk to me mother, don't burn me.
There is no one like my love anywhere,

lines.cyr: ни во турско мајко, ни каурско.
lines.lat: ni vo tursko majko, ni kaursko.
lines.en: not in Muslim lands, nor in Christian lands!
Not in Muslim lands, nor in Christian lands,
